output.english: This is a simulated flood drill for Richmond, VA. Floodwater is trapping people in Shockoe Bottom and Riverside Apartments, with fires and downed power lines in Downtown Junction, East Junction, and Broad & 3rd. Stay away from Dock St, Lee Bridge, and all floodwater.
output.spanish: Este es un simulacro de inundación para Richmond, VA. El agua está atrapando a personas en Shockoe Bottom y Riverside Apartments, con incendios y cables caídos en Downtown Junction, East Junction y Broad & 3rd. Manténgase lejos de Dock St, Lee Bridge y toda el agua acumulada.
